description: Takes a page out of draft mode so it gets its stored visibility (private/unlisted/public) and emits page.published; unlisted/public pages become visible to others. draft:true turns it back into a draft and returns a previewUrl (a share link that expires in 7 days). Without share|template scope on the slug the draft is still set but no link is created and the response carries previewSkipped:'missing_share_scope' (tell the user to review it on the web).

draft.description: false (default) = go live; true = back to draft

user.description: Page owner username (default: the connected account)

name: outbox_go_live
title: Outbox: publish a draft
